10 result(s) across 21st.dev (metadata only).

### [component] Expandable Card  [id: 35717]
by kuratlielia
A collapsible content card with a header trigger that smoothly morphs its width and height open to reveal more detail, built for dense dashboards or FAQ-style summaries.
preview: https://cdn.21st.dev/kuratlielia/expandable-card/default/preview.1791202723584-aafa9856-c3dc-498f-b2f6-31122141d4ff.png
install: npx shadcn@latest add "https://21st.dev/r/kuratlielia/expandable-card?api_key=$API_KEY_21ST"
→ get the code: get_component({ id: 35717 })

### [component] Collapsible Animated Card  [id: 24920]
by cnippet-dev
A card containing a collapsible FAQ item that smoothly expands and collapses its answer when the header is clicked.
preview: https://cdn.21st.dev/user_36Tbt0v8JdD4jEycmBFhR8tojnR/v-collapsible-3/default/preview.1787743210985.png
install: npx shadcn@latest add "https://21st.dev/r/cnippet-dev/v-collapsible-3?api_key=$API_KEY_21ST"
→ get the code: get_component({ id: 24920 })

### [component] Expanding Cards  [id: 5526]
by vaib215
An interactive, responsive card grid where one card expands on hover, focus, or click to reveal its content, while the others collapse. It is fully responsive, transitioning from a vertical layout on mobile to a horizontal grid on desktops.
preview: https://cdn.21st.dev/vaib215/expanding-cards/default/preview.1755290296595.png
install: npx shadcn@latest add "https://21st.dev/r/vaib215/expanding-cards?api_key=$API_KEY_21ST"
→ get the code: get_component({ id: 5526 })

### [component] Expandable Content Card  [id: 25336]
by cnippet-dev
A billing usage card that expands and collapses its content with a smooth max-height transition, a fade-out gradient overlay when collapsed, and a floating chevron toggle button.
preview: https://cdn.21st.dev/user_36Tbt0v8JdD4jEycmBFhR8tojnR/v-card-11/default/preview.1787263652872.webp
install: npx shadcn@latest add "https://21st.dev/r/cnippet-dev/v-card-11?api_key=$API_KEY_21ST"
→ get the code: get_component({ id: 25336 })

### [component] Accordion  [id: 19546]
by cnippet-dev
A vertically stacked set of collapsible sections built on Base UI's Accordion primitive. Supports single or multiple open items, controlled or uncontrolled state, a custom trigger icon, smooth height-animated panels, and nesting. Ships Accordion, AccordionItem, AccordionTrigger and AccordionPanel (also exported as AccordionContent).
preview: https://cdn.21st.dev/larsen66/cnippet-accordion/cards/preview.1783974792885.png
install: npx shadcn@latest add "https://21st.dev/r/cnippet-dev/cnippet-accordion?api_key=$API_KEY_21ST"
→ get the code: get_component({ id: 19546 })

### [component] Proximity Accordion  [id: 31839]
by ppramanik62
A collapsible accordion whose rows spring-animate open/closed height and chevron rotation, with a hover pill that previews the nearest row before you click.
preview: https://cdn.21st.dev/ppramanik62/accordion/multi-expand-accordion/preview.1790355129070-f05112c4-23fe-420e-8d2d-123517d8813f.png
install: npx shadcn@latest add "https://21st.dev/r/ppramanik62/accordion?api_key=$API_KEY_21ST"
→ get the code: get_component({ id: 31839 })

### [component] Privacy Policy Collapsible Card  [id: 24952]
by cnippet-dev
A privacy policy card with expandable accordion sections where only one panel opens at a time.
preview: https://cdn.21st.dev/user_36Tbt0v8JdD4jEycmBFhR8tojnR/v-collapsible-15/default/preview.1787692758913.png
install: npx shadcn@latest add "https://21st.dev/r/cnippet-dev/v-collapsible-15?api_key=$API_KEY_21ST"
→ get the code: get_component({ id: 24952 })

### [component] Accordion Multiple  [id: 29251]
by uiable
A vertically stacked accordion where several sections can be expanded open at the same time, useful for FAQ lists or collapsible content groups.
preview: https://cdn.21st.dev/user_registry_uiable_1783486969177/accordion-multiple/default/preview.1790097813127.webp
install: npx shadcn@latest add "https://21st.dev/r/uiable/accordion-multiple?api_key=$API_KEY_21ST"
→ get the code: get_component({ id: 29251 })

### [component] Accordion  [id: 23530]
by ddoemonn
An accessible, spring-animated accordion with single or multiple open panels, keyboard navigation, and auto-measured content height.
preview: https://cdn.21st.dev/ddoemonn/accordion/default/preview.1785472426900-c597a8dc-43a8-4b6c-a3c0-b3b6170cd61d.png
install: npx shadcn@latest add "https://21st.dev/r/ddoemonn/accordion?api_key=$API_KEY_21ST"
→ get the code: get_component({ id: 23530 })

### [component] Accordion  [id: 696]
by shadcn
A vertically stacked set of interactive headings that each reveal a section of content.
preview: https://cdn.21st.dev/user_shadcn/accordion/card-based/preview.png?v=1
install: npx shadcn@latest add "https://21st.dev/r/shadcn/accordion?api_key=$API_KEY_21ST"
